outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter/dot plots with individual mouse data points plus mean ± SD error bars overlaid, not just bars of averages.
Panel B is a photograph of gross mouse anatomy, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C consists of H&E and Oil Red O micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a dot blot / methylene blue staining image (a blot-type readout), not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue ratio bar graph displays individual data points (dots) for each of the 5 NC and 5 HFD mice overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
The bottom bar graph quantifying TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH ratios shows individual data points for each animal (n=6 NC, n=7 HFD) overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
